draft_problems: by 'Alejandro Bustillo': supported. (006 notes Bustillo refused to put his name on the facade and the idea came from Le Corbusier's earlier unbuilt project for another plot.)
year null in draft: pages consistently say 1928 (design / construction dates from 1928); no page gives 1929 (the universes.art page that said 1929 was not saved). Completion year not stated anywhere.

features 'Rationalist house influenced by Le Corbusier; National Historic Monument since 2022': supported by 004. 003 adds that Bustillo discarded Le Corbusier's free plan, double-height ceilings and ribbon windows, so 'influenced by Le Corbusier' is only partly true of the built house.
Concepts in draft (Geometry, Facade as skin, Light & shadow) are the researcher's picks, not from sources.
